{{Quote|Of course it's true! I oughtta know...I was there!|Unidentified moisture farmer to [[Conil Barje]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 7">[[Star Wars (1998) 7|''Star Wars'' (1998) 7]]</ref>}}
A '''[[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]]''' resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for an unknown period of time. He was seen at [[Mochot Steep/Legends|Mochot Steep]] where he spoke with [[Conil Barje]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He advised Barje that he, his wife, and child should have stayed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], rather than selling all of their possessions and relocating. While purchasing weapons to protect themselves from [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], this moisture farmer mentioned a time when he was in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during a recent raid. He described the battle as bloody and he was barely able to make his escape when the Sand People burned down half of the city.

Shortly afterward, this farmer was killed in a [[Attack on Mochot Steep|raid]] on Mochot Steep.
